name: Opik
short: Comet's open-source LLM observability and evaluation platform for tracing, testing, and optimizing AI applications and agents.

plans.name: Free Cloud
plans.notes: Up to 10 team members, 25,000 spans per month, 60-day data retention; full tracing, test suites, and agent playground included.

plans.name: Pro Cloud
plans.notes: Up to 50 team members, 100,000 spans per month, 60-day retention, customizable span limits and retention periods.

plans.name: Open Source
plans.notes: Self-hosted, same codebase as hosted; full feature set, you run and scale it.
